caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a rounded lid and ornate carvings on its surface. The chest is primarily light brown in color, with darker and lighter shades used to highlight texture and depth, giving the appearance of wood grain. The front panel of the chest is decorated with carved rectangular sections featuring floral and geometric patterns, including rosettes and stylized plants. There is a prominent black metal latch and hasp in the center, attached to the lid and the front. The sides of the chest also show carved detailing, including large floral motifs and additional woodwork designs. The legs and lower supports are made of the same wood and feature angular cutouts and decorative scalloping. The name "MAJEL CLAFLIN" is handwritten at the bottom right corner of the drawing. The background is plain and off-white, making the chest the central focus of the composition.
title: Casa en Mesita or Chest on Stand
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
